passage.text: You won't believe what happened to me last night!
passage.reading: juː ˈwoʊnt bɪˈliːv ˈwʌt ˈhæpənd tə miː ˈlæst ˈnaɪt!

passage.text: I was coming home from a concert, and I was trying to catch the last train.
passage.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈhoʊm frəm ə ˈkɑːnsərt, ənd aɪ wʌz ˈtraɪɪŋ tə ˈkætʃ ðə ˈlæst ˈtreɪn.

passage.text: I had been dancing for three hours, so I was really tired.
passage.reading: aɪ hæd bɪn ˈdænsɪŋ fər ˈθriː ˈaʊərz, soʊ aɪ wʌz ˈriːli ˈtaɪərd.

passage.text: I got on the subway, sat down and closed my eyes.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈɡɑːt ɑːn ðə ˈsʌbweɪ, ˈsæt ˈdaʊn ənd ˈkloʊzd maɪ ˈaɪz.

passage.text: When I opened them, the train had stopped, and everyone had gone.
passage.reading: wɛn aɪ ˈoʊpənd ðɛm, ðə ˈtreɪn hæd ˈstɑːpt, ənd ˈɛvriwʌn hæd ˈɡɔːn.

passage.text: It was the last station, and it was almost midnight!
passage.reading: ɪt wʌz ðə ˈlæst ˈsteɪʃən, ənd ɪt wʌz ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈmɪdnaɪt!

passage.text: To my horror, the station was closing, and there were no more trains.
passage.reading: tə maɪ ˈhɔːrər, ðə ˈsteɪʃən wʌz ˈkloʊzɪŋ, ənd ðɛr wɜːr ˈnoʊ ˈmɔːr ˈtreɪnz.

passage.text: I was standing outside the station, feeling a bit scared, when an old woman came over to me.
passage.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈstændɪŋ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə ˈsteɪʃən, ˈfiːlɪŋ ə ˈbɪt ˈskɛrd, wɛn ən ˈoʊld ˈwʊmən ˈkeɪm ˈoʊvər tə miː.

passage.text: She was selling flowers, and she asked if I was OK.
passage.reading: ʃiː wʌz ˈsɛlɪŋ ˈflaʊərz, ənd ʃiː ˈæskt ɪf aɪ wʌz oʊˈkeɪ.

passage.text: She didn't speak much English, but she understood my problem right away.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈdɪdənt ˈspiːk ˈmʌtʃ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ, bʌt ʃiː ˌʌndərˈstʊd maɪ ˈprɑːbləm ˈraɪt əˈweɪ.

passage.text: Then she called her son, who was a taxi driver, and he gave me a ride home!
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ʃiː ˈkɔːld hɜːr ˈsʌn, huː wʌz ə ˈtæksi ˈdraɪvər, ənd hiː ˈɡeɪv miː ə ˈraɪd ˈhoʊm!

passage.text: He didn't even let me pay!
passage.reading: hiː ˈdɪdənt ˈiːvən ˈlɛt miː ˈpeɪ!

passage.text: They were so kind-hearted, and I didn't even get their names.
passage.reading: ðeɪ wɜːr soʊ ˌkaɪndˈhɑːrtɪd, ənd aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈiːvən ˈɡɛt ðɛr ˈneɪmz.

passage.text: Could you help me write a thank-you note in Thai?
passage.reading: kʊd juː ˈhɛlp miː ˈraɪt ə ˈθæŋk juː ˌnoʊt ɪn ˈtaɪ?

passage.text: I want to take it to the flower seller with some fruit.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈteɪk ɪt tə ðə ˈflaʊər ˈsɛlər wɪð sʌm ˈfruːt.

passage.text: Call me back when you get this!
passage.reading: ˈkɔːl miː ˈbæk wɛn juː ˈɡɛt ˈðɪs!
